# DotComma

> DotComma is a constrained-language game: players rewrite lines using only
> short, plain words from a small shared vocabulary. It is the playful
> onboarding layer for a low-friction "bridge language" — a simple, shared
> way to communicate across English, Mandarin, Vietnamese and other
> language communities.

## How it works
- Each round gives you a line to rewrite using only allowed short words.
- Valid words show green; off-list words show red.
- All-valid answers score highest, with a small bonus for brevity.
- After submitting you see other players' top answers and can like them.

## Pages
- [Play DotComma](https://dotcomma.com.au/): the game.
- [About](https://dotcomma.com.au/about): the bridge-language vision.
- [How to play](https://dotcomma.com.au/how-to-play): rules, scoring, vocabulary.

## About
DotComma is free to play in any web browser. It is an early-stage project
exploring how a constrained, universal vocabulary can help people write and
communicate more simply across languages.
